basic_info.description: Exceptional custom-built 3BD/3.5BA Diamond Hts urban retreat w/stunning Glen Canyon Park views & spa-like amenities. Open & airy floor plan includes a FLR w/fireplace, picturesque canyon views & a spacious balcony. The adjacent FDR, designed to enjoy the outdoor scenery & the warm ambiance of the home, provides ample space for gatherings. The well-appointed chef's kitchen offers sleek cabinetry, generous counter space, a casual dining area, and a half BA nearby. Upstairs, an incredible solarium offers a light-filled retreat w/walls of glass that showcase The Canyon. The roomy primary suite easily features a fireplace, bonus den, big closets, seating area, workspace, and an ensuite stone BA w/walk-in shower. Two additional ample BDs, and a large BA w/laundry, are located nearby. The home's lower level boasts a family room w/view balcony, wet bar & private spa-like retreat that includes an indoor hot tub, steam sauna & BA. A full finished basement, perfect for home gym or hobbies, a big 2-car garage, and modern updates including solar, fresh paint & wood floors, complete this comprehensive offering. Excellent location, steps to Diamond Hts. Shopping, hiking trails, public transit, and just minutes to Noe Valley, West Portal & freeways, ensures seamless connectivity SF & beyond.
